metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1997 · Cop Land
metas.description: The Sheriff of a suburban New Jersey community, populated by New York City police officers, slowly discovers the town is a front for mob connections and corruption.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 1997 · Con Air
metas.description: Former US Army Ranger, Cameron Poe, has just been paroled for manslaughter, but must stop a group of violent and deadly criminals from escaping the country after they seize control of the prison transport plane he is on.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 1996 · Twister
metas.description: Two storm chasers on the brink of divorce must work together to create an advanced weather alert system by putting themselves in the cross-hairs of extremely violent tornadoes.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 1999 · The World Is Not Enough
metas.description: James Bond uncovers a nuclear plot while protecting an oil heiress from her former kidnapper, an international terrorist who can't feel pain.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 1997 · Event Horizon
metas.description: A rescue crew is tasked with investigating the mysterious reappearance of a spaceship that had been lost for seven years.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 1997 · Tomorrow Never Dies
metas.description: James Bond is sent to disrupt a media mogul's plot to foment a war between China and the United Kingdom.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 1998 · Godzilla
metas.description: French nuclear tests irradiate an iguana into a giant monster that heads off to New York City. The American military must chase the monster across the city to stop it before it reproduces.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 1999 · The Ninth Gate
metas.description: An unscrupulous dealer of rare books finds himself at the heart of a string of paranormal events when he is hired to find the last two copies of a text capable of summoning the devil.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 1993 · Demolition Man
metas.description: A police officer is brought out of suspended animation in prison to pursue an old ultra-violent nemesis who is loose in a non-violent future society.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 1985 · Rambo: First Blood Part II
metas.description: Ex-Green Beret goes on a reconnaissance mission to spring MIAs from a Viet Cong prison.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 1987 · The Running Man
metas.description: In a future dystopian America, a wrongfully accused and convicted policeman gets his shot at freedom when he's forced to participate in a TV game show where convicts called Runners must battle killers for their freedom.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 1996 · The Cable Guy
metas.description: A designer makes a grievous mistake when he rejects the friendship of a borderline cable guy.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 1992 · Lethal Weapon 3
metas.description: Martin Riggs and Roger Murtaugh pursue a former LAPD officer who uses his knowledge of police procedure and policies to steal and sell confiscated guns and ammunition to local street gangs.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 1985 · Commando
metas.description: A retired Special Forces colonel tries to save his daughter, who was abducted by his former subordinate.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 1998 · Lethal Weapon 4
metas.description: With personal crises and age weighing in on them, LAPD officers Riggs and Murtaugh must contend with deadly Chinese triads that are trying to free their former leaders out of prison and onto American soil.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 1980 · Friday the 13th
metas.description: A group of teenage camp counselors attempt to re-open an abandoned summer camp with a tragic past, but they are stalked by a mysterious, relentless killer.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 1993 · The Firm
metas.description: A law school graduate uncovers a sinister secret about the Memphis firm that made him an offer he couldn't refuse.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 1987 · Hellraiser
metas.description: A woman discovers the newly resurrected, partially formed, body of her brother-in-law and lover. She starts killing for him to revitalize his body and escape the demonic beings that are pursuing him after he escaped their underworld.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 1988 · Rambo III
metas.description: Loner Rambo leaves a Buddhist monastery to free his Green Beret mentor from Soviets in Afghanistan.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 1993 · Cliffhanger
metas.description: Two mountain rescuers are forced to guide a group of thieves to their missing loot.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 1995 · Outbreak
metas.description: A team of Army doctors struggle to find a cure for the deadly Motaba virus that was transported from Africa to North America by a white-headed Capuchin monkey and is now spreading quickly throughout a small California town.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 1965 · Thunderball
metas.description: James Bond heads to the Bahamas to recover two nuclear warheads stolen by S.P.E.C.T.R.E. Agent Emilio Largo in an international extortion scheme.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 1988 · Child's Play
metas.description: A dying serial killer transfers his consciousness into a popular kids doll using voodoo. A struggling single mother gifts her six-year-old son the much sought-after doll for his birthday, and the doll slowly begins to show its tru...

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 1992 · Patriot Games
metas.description: When CIA analyst Jack Ryan interferes with an IRA assassination, a renegade faction targets him and his family for revenge.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 1967 · You Only Live Twice
metas.description: James Bond and the Japanese Secret Service must find and stop the true culprit of a series of space hijackings, before war is provoked between Russia and the United States.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1977 · The Spy Who Loved Me
metas.description: James Bond investigates the hijacking of British and Russian submarines carrying nuclear warheads, with the help of a K.G.B. agent whose lover he killed.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 1973 · Live and Let Die
metas.description: James Bond is sent to stop a diabolically brilliant heroin magnate armed with a complex organisation and a reliable psychic tarot card reader.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 1989 · Pet Sematary
metas.description: After tragedy strikes, a grieving father discovers an ancient burial ground behind his home with the power to raise the dead.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 1996 · Eraser
metas.description: A Witness Protection specialist becomes suspicious of his co-workers when dealing with a case involving high-tech weapons.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 1971 · Diamonds Are Forever
metas.description: A diamond smuggling investigation leads James Bond to Las Vegas where he uncovers an evil plot involving a rich business tycoon.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 1974 · The Man with the Golden Gun
metas.description: James Bond is targeted by the world's most expensive assassin, while he attempts to recover sensitive solar cell technology that is being sold to the highest bidder.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 1989 · Licence to Kill
metas.description: A vengeful James Bond goes rogue to infiltrate and take down the organization of a drug lord who has murdered his friend's new wife and left him near death.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 1998 · U.S. Marshals
metas.description: U.S. Marshal Samuel Gerard and his team of Marshals are assigned to track down Sheridan, who has been accused of a double-murder.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 1983 · Octopussy
metas.description: A fake Fabergé egg recovered from the body of a fellow agent leads James Bond to uncover a jewel smuggling operation led by the mysterious Octopussy, and a plot to blow up a NATO air base.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 1998 · Sphere
metas.description: A spaceship is discovered under three hundred years' worth of coral growth at the bottom of the ocean.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 1981 · For Your Eyes Only
metas.description: Secret service agent James Bond is assigned to find a missing British vessel equipped with a weapons encryption device and prevent it from falling into enemy hands.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 1987 · The Living Daylights
metas.description: James Bond is sent to investigate a KGB policy to kill all enemy spies, and uncovers an arms deal that potentially has major global ramifications.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 1985 · A View to a Kill
metas.description: The recovery of a microchip from the body of a fellow British secret agent leads James Bond to mad industrialist Max Zorin, who is scheming to cause massive destruction.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 1989 · Road House
metas.description: A legendary bouncer comes to restore order at a notorious bar but runs afoul of a ruthless crime boss who controls the town.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 1987 · Fatal Attraction
metas.description: A married man's one-night stand comes back to haunt him when that lover begins to stalk him and his family.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 1996 · Broken Arrow
metas.description: Terrorists steal nuclear warheads from the U.S. military but don't count on a pilot and park ranger spoiling their plans.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 1999 · The Thomas Crown Affair
metas.description: A very rich and successful playboy amuses himself by stealing artwork, but may have met his match in a seductive detective.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 1992 · Candyman
metas.description: The Candyman, a murderous soul with a hook for a hand, is accidentally summoned to reality by a skeptic grad student researching the monster's myth.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 1969 · On Her Majesty's Secret Service
metas.description: British agent James Bond goes undercover to pursue the villainous Ernst Stavro Blofeld, who is planning to hold the world to ransom.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 1997 · Dante's Peak
metas.description: A volcanologist arrives at a countryside town recently named the second-most desirable place to live in America, and discovers that a nearby long-dormant volcano may awaken at any moment.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 1983 · Christine
metas.description: A nerdish boy buys a strange car with an evil mind of its own and his nature starts to change to reflect it.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 1992 · Under Siege
metas.description: Ex US Navy Seal turned cook, Casey Ryback, is the only person who can stop a group of terrorists when they seize control of the US battleship The Missouri to obtain it's nuclear warheads.
